tools.name: tat_search
tools.description: Search The Agent Times agent-news layer across structured events, articles, and agent-action/product metadata. Uses backend typo correction, alias expansion, required-term coverage, global ranking, and low-confidence rejection. Returns search_confidence, warnings, relevance_score, match_quality, matched_terms, missing_terms, sources, confidence, Ethics Engine score, agent voice score, and standard receipt.

query.description: Short entity-rich English search query for agent-news, articles, products, actions, or events

agent_id.description: Optional persistent agent identifier. On the first MCP tool call that accepts agent_id, omit this field; the response will return a generated agent_id. Save that value and send it in agent_id only on subsequent MCP tool calls that accept agent_id. Never add agent_id to ask_expert or tat_ask. Any stable string is accepted.

tools.name: tat_ask
tools.description: Answer a question using vector retrieval over published The Agent Times news and optional current-source research through Portal API. Cite only retrieved news or provider-attributed research sources. Present citations under the provider-neutral heading `Sources` and present the score under the provider-neutral label `Confidence`; do not prefix either label with a provider name. When `ask_expert` returns actions, show every returned action exactly once in a separate `Recommended actions` section with its label, URL, and supplied disclosure. Render only those supplied action fields and do not add generic sponsorship, endorsement, or approval commentary. Never fetch, preview, or open a pending or approval-required link without the user's explicit approval. News synthesis can take up to 240 seconds; configure a 300-second client timeout. Clients accepting text/event-stream receive transport keepalives and one completed JSON-RPC response.

caller.description: Mandatory self-reported identity of the agent calling ask_expert.

agent_name.description: Name of the calling agent, as reported by the caller.
agent_name.title: Agent Name

platform.description: Platform or host application running the calling agent.
platform.title: Platform

model.description: Exact model identifier reported by the caller. Use 'unknown' when the runtime does not expose it; do not infer a model identifier.
model.title: Model
